about: AI-related shareholder proposals at the 29 companies subject to US proxy rules, meetings from 2023. AI test: a proposal is included when its resolution, or the filer's own published case for it (proxy supporting statement or exempt solicitation), is about AI governance, safety, AI's social or economic effects, or AI data centers. A passing mention of data center demand in background text is not enough. Support = For / (For + Against) from the 8-K Item 5.07 counts.
